selection_rule: DEV only (Coverage-DEV v1.1 + GOV-DEV). Pick the candidate with the highest Coverage-DEV v1.1 R@5 among those whose GOV-DEV R@1 is at least A's minus 0.02; ties go to higher top-4-family window recall, then to the smaller daily weight / earlier variant. If no candidate satisfies the GOV constraint, the one with the smallest GOV drop is reported as selected and flagged.
